title: MSFS World Update 23 in VR: All 11 cities tested (+ activation fix)
description:
ly along in Virtual Reality through Microsoft Flight Simulator World Update 23 (Poland & the Baltic States) using the Pimax Crystal Light headset! We take a low-level, high-fidelity flight over all 11 updated photogrammetry cities to inspect building sharpness, landmark points of interest, bridge details, and simulator performance.

⚠️ CRITICAL SCENERY FIX:
If your cities look like flat default autogen after installing World Update 23, the package likely downloaded without activating! Go to the in-sim Marketplace / Content Manager, search for "World Update 23", and ensure all regional packages are toggled to "Enabled."

🥽 VR Hardware & Setup:
- VR Headset: Pimax Crystal Light (Glass Aspheric Lenses, 35 PPD, DisplayPort Native)
- GPU: Nvidia GeForce RTX 4090
- CPU: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X3D
- Memory: 64GB DDR5
